desc: No one works harder than a rancher or a farmer. And their work environment can put a variety of demands on a simple folding knife. The Ranch Boss II can meet just about any challenge your work can dish out! Designed from the ground up for usefulness, durability and effectiveness, it offers a long, sharp, clip point blade that's flat ground out of high carbon steel. Honed razor sharp it folds up into an equally tough handle. Made with faux sawed bone handle scales and reinforced with tough stainless steel bolsters, it will outlast nearly any brass frame folding knife. It comes with a stiff back spring and a stainless steel liner lock, so your fingers will have extra protection. Includes brown leather sheath.
